header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH,
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
body: None present on behalf of the petitioner nor any intimation is received. This petition was filed in the year 2024 and lastly fixed in Court on 04.11.2024. Thereafter, no efforts have been made by the petitioner to fix the matter in Court and to proceed with the matter. It appears that petitioner has lost interest in the matter. Accordingly, this petition is dismissed for non-prosecution.
